display_name: Sur La Table cooking-class offline clone

frozen_journeys.description: One authenticated local account reviews a server-priced cooking class for one guest, selects only an opaque sandbox outcome, confirms the booking, and sees the $99.00 USD total persist after refresh.
A declined or retryable sandbox attempt creates no booking. A later approved scenario against the same server-owned class snapshot can create exactly one account-owned booking.

payment_contract.amount_source: Server-side integer minor units equal to persisted class-session price multiplied by validated party size. The client cannot submit an amount, tax, fee, deposit, discount, or gratuity.
payment_contract.owner: Authenticated site-local account subject resolved from the opaque session cookie.
payment_contract.fingerprint: SHA-256 over canonical JSON containing class session id, party size, and authenticated account subject.
payment_contract.final_commit: consume_approval(), capacity reservation, and booking insertion run on one SiteBackend SQLite connection and transaction. Failure leaves no booking and does not reserve capacity.

proof_obligations: Only opaque configured sandbox scenario ids are accepted. Payment credentials and client-supplied amounts are rejected.
Amounts use integer USD minor units derived from class price and party size on the server.
Duplicate approved submissions converge to one booking and one consumed approval.
Declined and retryable attempts create no booking, while a later approval can create the single valid booking.
A stale class fingerprint or foreign owner cannot consume an approval or read a booking.
Approval consumption, capacity reservation, and booking insertion roll back together after final-state failure.
Reset clears site-local payment and booking rows, while restart retains them with site binding.
The only adapter is local-sandbox. Stripe test, live payment, SMTP, and production mail requests remain unavailable.
Cross-site databases, accounts, sessions, payment flows, attempts, and bookings cannot be shared or replayed.
